summary: Gate for work-queue: one added line, work-queue#r33. 1 question.
questions: Approve the added work-queue line [r33] (new, under spec/capabilities/work-queue.md): "**While** a request that an initiative raised into an upstream is not `delivered`, `work status` shall print the initiative as waiting on that request." It pairs with supervision r136, which holds back work-items for the capability-proposal while the request is not delivered. Readings: (A) approve the line as drafted [recommended]; (B) drop it, so `work status` says nothing about such a wait; (C) reword it, in which case give the wording.
